delivered_text.receipt_note: the dispatch rows carry no 'relisten' receipt on this branch (the outputs.jsonl persistence is a concurrent engineering item); the per-row relisten spend is proven instead as the E4-1 minus AGREE contact_count, which must equal the captured relisten contacts of the row

findings.detail: the dispatch row's contact_count(E4-1) - contact_count(AGREE) equals the row's captured relisten contacts on 0 of 120 rows (histogram of the delta {'0': 120}) while 240 relisten contacts reached the (fake) transport: the per-row contact_count the runner reports does not count the post-accept relisten contacts. The flight's plan budget is enforced on the shared client, which does see them; the per-row contact accounting (and any smoke inspection that compares it with the trace or with the receipt's contacts_used) is an engineering item for the relisten wiring, not for this registration.

hash_quoting: 64-hex identities other than the prepared-supply output digests and the study commit are quoted as sha256-prefix16:<first 16 hex> (core.flight.repin rewrites package JSON from old identity hashes to new ones at the flip and refuses any old hash left under docs/)

agree_arm.source: the AGREE arm's committed artifact (the one that flew), read raw -- not re-minted

program_identity_fields: the two model-visible fields the program switch moves (normalise_program_identity): (1) the program id inside every quoted prior contact id (no invocation index moves: E4-1 adds no role invocation before ACCEPT); (2) remaining_model_contacts in the task-state block (17 minus spent against 11 minus spent: +6 on every contact)
question: Is E4-1's delivered path (every Perception, Solver, Reviewer and Planner contact, and the delivered text) the retained AGREE arm's own under the 17-ceiling relisten program, with the relisten contacts strictly extra, post-accept, blind to the delivered value and never altering the delivered text?

request_bytes.method: the decision-160 method (P160.capture_requests): FlightRuntime._dispatch_phase_program(model_free_check=True) on each cell's own composed fragments, against the composed model fragment's REAL llama-server transport with its POST replaced by a fake server that records the body bytes and answers a canned completion identical for both cells (the Solver answer carries one fixed 'date' entity so the relisten stage fires; the blind answer alternates heard=false / a different heard value by sha256(sample_id); the confirm answers 'A'); dispatched serially under ONE common scratch run id; the AGREE side with its unloadable committed supply pin lifted (proof 2 shows the live supply equals the committed output)
